meta.title: Product Walkthrough
meta.audience: Buyers and operators evaluating the product
meta.purpose: Walk a real product surface end to end, not a feature list

slides.title: Show the product, not the pitch.
slides.body: A guided tour built from real screens, numbered callouts, and a clock the presenter can actually keep.
slides.notes: Open on what the audience will see, then move straight to the product surface.

slides.title: Start at the screen people actually use.
slides.body: Every chapter in this deck opens as a question, so the audience always knows what is being answered.

slides.title: Four moves, one screen.
slides.body: Numbered callouts sit on the product surface itself, and every one stays editable text in PowerPoint.

visual.alt: Product console with navigation, summary cards and a work queue

callouts.title: Find the work
callouts.body: Filter down to what is yours

slides.notes: Walk the four callouts in order. Do not read the labels aloud; narrate the decision at each step.
